body: I think it might be better to have separate `$version` and `$hash` variables. To cache the output/parsed version you can use `once_cell::sync::Lazy`.

Hey, thanks a lot for the suggestions. I implemented the hash as a variable and used the match pattern. Much better indeed!

However, I'm struggling to understand how `Lazy` will be beneficial here. Since the module function will need to be executed anyway when `parsed` is used, wouldn't the function inside `Lazy` be called the same amount of times with or without `Lazy`? I see only a delay in the function call
The version is not necessarily included in the format string, and in that case getting the version can be skipped altogether.
Oh well, I wouldn't expect someone to use this without showing the version. But since it's a possibility, I believe I have it implemented now 👍.
